in_hebrew.name: פלורידיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A feminine name derived from the Hebrew word 'prd', which means 'to flow'. The name Floridia is derived from the Latin word 'flos' meaning 'flower', and the suffix '-idia' meaning 'belonging to'. Thus, Floridia can be translated as 'belonging to the flower' or 'blossoming'. In the Hebrew language, this name can be written as 'פלורידיה' (Ploridia) and pronounced as 'plo-ree-DEE-ah'.

in_greek.name: Φλωριδία
in_greek.long_meaning: Floridia is a name of Greek origin, derived from the Greek word 'phloros' meaning 'flower'. The suffix '-idia' means 'belonging to'. Thus, Floridia can be translated as 'belonging to the flower' or 'flowering'. In the Greek language, this name can be written as 'Φλωριδία' (Phloridia) and pronounced as 'flor-id-EE-ah'.

in_latin.name: Floridia
in_latin.long_meaning: Floridia is a Latin name, derived from the Latin word 'flos' meaning 'flower'. The suffix '-idia' means 'belonging to'. Thus, Floridia can be translated as 'belonging to the flower' or 'flowering'. In the Latin language, this name can be written as 'Floridia' and pronounced as 'flor-i-DI-ah'.
